content:
Campaign agency and reimbursement terms. Monetary records use USD cents: 100 cents equal USD 1. Queries and preparation do not advance the logical clock. Owner approval binds the exact parameters; only execute_request executes a proposal. Repeating an executed request is idempotent; a newly approved grant is a new transfer.

The campaign wallet belongs to the campaign operator and is separate from the external sponsor's grant capacity. The creative studio's recorded amount must be paid by its inclusive due minute. pay_creative accepts positive partial transfers from the wallet; cumulative payment above the invoice is an overpayment and there is no refund operation. Historical amounts are already included in opening balances. The independent contracted owner contribution arrives at its recorded minute, and cannot be spent before that event.

At minute two the fulfillment/return statement replaces provisional eligible merchant expenditure. The two possible fulfillment statements are Alder USD 70, Birch USD 40 and Cedar USD 10, or Alder USD 30, Birch USD 60 and Cedar USD 30. In minor units these are (7000,4000,1000) and (3000,6000,3000). The final statement establishes which spending amounts qualify; provisional amounts cannot certify the final entitlement. Merchant reimbursement is measured against this final amount, not gross provisional spending. Every merchant's sponsor_paid_minor plus owner_paid_minor must equal its finally eligible expenditure. The minimum sponsored part is ceil(final_eligible_minor times minimum_sponsor_bp / 10000). The customer can require a sponsored share independently of receiving the same total from the campaign owner.

At minute zero each merchant must irrevocably elect DIRECT_FINAL or ADJUSTABLE_AGENCY. DIRECT_FINAL fixes direct sponsor-to-merchant cash routing: there is no advance and no agency fee. ADJUSTABLE_AGENCY credits the recorded agency advance to the operator wallet immediately and charges the recorded agency fee. This is temporary sponsor money which can bridge campaign expenses, not additional owner funding. The election cannot be switched later. Each merchant has separate advance and fee terms; fees are not refunded. After the final statement, an agency award must be finalized by adjust_agency: the sponsor credits award_minor minus advance_received_minor when positive, or the wallet returns its absolute value when negative. Only one adjustment is available and no additional award can be claimed for that agency afterward. The operator then remits the entire actual sponsor award to that merchant. This remittance is distinct from owner co-funding. DIRECT_FINAL claims instead pay the merchant directly, without entering the wallet.

The single sponsor cap applies across all merchants and all claims, not separately to each merchant. claim_sponsor is accepted after the final statement, through the sponsor deadline, subject to the merchant's individual claim limit, final eligible expenditure and the sponsor's remaining shared capacity. It records a final award for the named merchant: under DIRECT_FINAL it immediately pays that merchant; under ADJUSTABLE_AGENCY the adjustment and remittance remain necessary. Claims consume the cap by award amount, not the temporary advance amount. A merchant can locally receive more than its minimum sponsor share. Grants are final paid programme awards; there is no same-period surrender, reversal, assignment, reallocation, recoverable receivable or outside sponsor capacity. A grant to one merchant permanently consumes the same shared cap needed by the other merchants. The bank checks each local claim's limits, not the operator's obligations to other merchants.

pay_cofunding pays the named merchant directly from the operator's wallet. It does not restore sponsor capacity and cannot replace a contractually required sponsor share. The bank accepts any positive amount that the wallet can fund, including early transfers; it does not infer the merchant's final entitlement. All merchant payments must be complete by minute three. There is no additional funding or merchant recovery mandate.

Unlock propose_platform_campaign. Every request contains case_id, action and data. elect_campaign data is {record_id: campaign_merchant ID, mode: DIRECT_FINAL or ADJUSTABLE_AGENCY}. adjust_agency data is {record_id: campaign_merchant ID}. remit_sponsor data is {record_id: campaign_merchant ID, amount_minor: positive integer}. pay_creative data is {amount_minor: positive integer}. claim_sponsor and pay_cofunding data is {record_id: campaign_merchant ID, amount_minor: positive integer}. Only one final case outcome may be recorded.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_platform_campaign`

Prepare a campaign routing election, creative payment, sponsor award, actual agency cash adjustment, sponsor remittance or merchant owner contribution.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
title: Shared sponsor grants and merchant campaign co-funding
